title: tui: a detail pane for the selected issue
body: What foam show prints, beside or below the board: body, notes, blockers, children, lease.
close_reason: Enter opens the issue as foam show prints it, with its notes; j/k scroll, Esc back; unit test on the detail lines at width 40

notes.author: Jack Roddy/6de6737a
notes.text: Done: Mode::Detail over the rows, entered with Enter, l or Right, left with Esc, h, Left or Backspace; q quits from anywhere. detail() mirrors render::issue line for line in spans, wrapped with render::wrap_at (now pub) at the body width, notes with a two-space hanging indent. Full screen rather than a split pane; a split for wide terminals is a later issue if wanted. The cursor survives reload and the detail of an issue a reload removed falls back to the rows.
